images.filename: Charging mobile phones and light bulbs is a business inside UN House, Juba (12317290513).jpg
images.caption:
Small business is thriving inside UN House, Juba. Market stalls and restaurants line the makeshift streets of the camp, where residents can find everything from soap, food, shoes and clothing to nail polish and phone and light bulb-charging services. 

Oxfam/Aimee Brown
images.alt:

images.filename: Building latrines has been part of Oxfam's water and sanitation support at UN House, Juba (12317325683).jpg
images.caption:
Oxfam has helped build over 200 latrines in the UN House camp in Juba. The latrines are cleaned daily and Oxfam also supports 60 hygiene promotion volunteers to raise awareness about the importance of good hygiene practices. 

Oxfam/Aimee Brown
